newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse lifts suspension Redeco.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse lifts suspension Redeco.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange said on Monday it has lifted a trading suspension on the stock of Republic Resources and Development Corp (Redeco).
In an advisory to brokers, the stock exchange said that the only Redeco stocks that can be traded are those whose stock certificates carry a par value of one peso each.
Philippine Stock Exchange officials said the par value of Redeco shares has been increased to one peso from one centavos after new owners bought into the company.
Redeco also reclassified its shares to only one type.

Redeco A shares, open to Filipinos only, were last traded on September 13, 1994 and closed at 0.5 centavos while its B shares, open to both Filipinos and foreigners, closed at 0.75 centavos on the same day. Redeco shares traded at 10.75 pesos after hitting a high of 22 pesos in early trade on Monday.
